name: background-task-lifecycle
description: Tests that delegated tasks complete their full lifecycle (spawn → completion) via the orchestrator. Uses background_task_completed assertion to verify the task result state reflects terminal status.

evals.prompt: @fixer Create src/utils/evals/background-test.ts that exports a function formatTimestamp(date: Date): string that returns an ISO string.
evals.description: A @fixer task should complete its lifecycle — the task tool call result must show terminal state

assertions.description: The fixer task must reach completed state in the transcript
The file should actually be created with the function

evals.prompt: @explorer Find all files in src/hooks/ that import from '../config' and list their imports.
evals.description: An @explorer task should complete its lifecycle

assertions.description: The explorer task must reach completed state

evals.prompt: @oracle For a small in-memory cache, is a Map or a plain object the better choice? Give a one-sentence answer.
evals.description: An @oracle task should complete its lifecycle

assertions.description: The oracle task must reach completed state

evals.prompt: Research what the latest MCP spec changes are, then create a simple wrapper at src/utils/evals/mcp-wrapper.ts.
evals.description: When multiple agents are delegated, all task lifecycle events should complete

assertions.description: All background tasks must reach completed state
